d:
Every journey has a story, but some take you into mysteries that have remained hidden for centuries. In Expedition Unknown, Josh Gates travels across the world, following clues and uncovering stories buried in history.
From forgotten chapters of the past and ancient civilisations to legendary treasures and remarkable discoveries, these expeditions take Josh through extraordinary places in search of answers. Each journey brings a new mystery, a fresh discovery and another reason to keep exploring.
Watch Expedition Unknown, Season 8, Episodes 1, 15, 9, 6, 14, 4 & 5 on Discovery Channel India.
